report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified. Current traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and DB spans returning 200/ok. Order metrics show only 200s on /v1/orders with no 502s, and the sole deployment record (order 1.0.0) cannot establish causation. No current evidence establishes a bounded fault; hand off for error telemetry and broader deployment/log data.

Deployment records for checkout/payment/inventory services, not only order, to test deployment-caused fault
Logs for order service (excluded evidence ev-68757353a5d2590b-r0-logs_order) to check for errors
